meta.description: Sample dataset for AI Opportunity Mapping Tool. Retail insurance context. ~30 use cases across 6 business domains, 8 implementation enablers.

impact_factors.name: Revenue growth
impact_factors.description: Direct contribution to top-line revenue — new income streams, higher conversion, increased wallet share.

impact_factors.name: Cost reduction / efficiency
impact_factors.description: Reduction in operating cost, headcount requirement, processing time or error rates.

impact_factors.name: Risk reduction
impact_factors.description: Reduction in regulatory, operational, underwriting, claims or reputational risk exposure.

impact_factors.name: Customer experience
impact_factors.description: Improvement in policyholder satisfaction, retention, NPS or perceived service quality.

impact_factors.name: Strategic differentiation
impact_factors.description: Contribution to competitive positioning, brand, market share or capability that is hard to replicate.

impact_factors.name: Employee experience
impact_factors.description: Improvement in staff productivity, satisfaction, or reduction in low-value workload.

readiness_factors.name: Data availability & quality
readiness_factors.description: Whether the data required to power this use case exists, is accessible, sufficiently clean, and usable within regulatory and consent constraints.

readiness_factors.name: Technical infrastructure
readiness_factors.description: Whether cloud, compute, storage, API connectivity and integration architecture required are in place or readily established.

readiness_factors.name: Governance & compliance readiness
readiness_factors.description: Whether appropriate AI policies, model risk frameworks, regulatory approvals and audit trails are in place for this type of use case.

readiness_factors.name: Organisational & process readiness
readiness_factors.description: Whether business processes, roles, handoff points and change management capability needed to embed this use case are mature enough.

readiness_factors.name: Skills & capability
readiness_factors.description: Whether internal skills (technical, domain, AI literacy) needed to build, operate and govern this use case are available or accessible.

readiness_factors.name: Implementation effort
readiness_factors.description: Inverse of implementation complexity — high score means lower effort/cost/risk. Acts as a practical friction factor.

readiness_factors.name: Executive & stakeholder support
readiness_factors.description: Whether there is clear sponsorship, budget commitment and stakeholder alignment for this use case.

implementation_enablers.name: Unified data platform & MLOps infrastructure
implementation_enablers.description: A modern cloud-based data platform with data lake, feature store and MLOps tooling, providing a single foundation for ingesting, transforming and serving data to AI models at scale.

implementation_enablers.name: Data governance & metadata management programme
implementation_enablers.description: Establishing data ownership, quality standards, a business glossary and metadata catalogue across the organisation's core data assets. Foundation for trustworthy AI outputs.

implementation_enablers.name: AI governance framework & model risk policy
implementation_enablers.description: An enterprise AI acceptable use policy, model risk management framework (covering model validation, monitoring and documentation), and a defined regulatory engagement plan for AI.

implementation_enablers.name: Cloud infrastructure & API modernisation
implementation_enablers.description: Migration of core policy, claims and customer systems to cloud-native architecture with open APIs, enabling integration with AI tooling and third-party data sources.

implementation_enablers.name: AI skills & literacy programme
implementation_enablers.description: Structured upskilling across three tiers: executive AI literacy, practitioner training for business and operations staff, and technical capability development for data and engineering teams.

implementation_enablers.name: Unstructured data & document intelligence platform
implementation_enablers.description: A vector database and document processing pipeline capable of ingesting, chunking and embedding policy documents, claims notes, correspondence and regulatory text for use in RAG-based AI applications.

implementation_enablers.name: Customer data & consent management
implementation_enablers.description: A unified customer data platform with consent management, identity resolution across channels, and GDPR-compliant data lineage. Prerequisite for personalisation and customer-facing AI use cases.

implementation_enablers.name: Process standardisation & workflow automation foundation
implementation_enablers.description: Documentation and standardisation of core operational processes (claims handling, underwriting referral, customer onboarding), with a low-code automation layer to support human-AI handoff design.

use_cases.name: Automated first notification of loss (FNOL) triage
use_cases.description: Use NLP to classify incoming claims by type, complexity and urgency at point of first contact, routing straightforward claims to automated fast-track and complex claims to specialist handlers.

use_cases.name: AI-assisted claims liability assessment
use_cases.description: Provide claims handlers with an AI-generated liability recommendation based on policy terms, incident details and historical case outcomes, with supporting evidence surfaced from similar past claims.

use_cases.name: Claims fraud detection — motor
use_cases.description: Apply machine learning to motor claims data to score each claim for fraud indicators at point of FNOL, flagging high-risk cases for specialist investigation before settlement.

use_cases.name: Claims fraud detection — home & contents
use_cases.description: Extend the motor fraud detection model to home and contents claims, incorporating additional signals such as social media and address history to improve detection rates.

use_cases.name: Automated claims document extraction & summarisation
use_cases.description: Use document intelligence to extract key information from unstructured claims documents (medical reports, police reports, invoices) and present structured summaries to handlers, reducing manual review time.

use_cases.name: Predictive underwriting risk scoring — motor
use_cases.description: Replace or augment actuarial rating factors with an ML model that incorporates telematics, third-party data and behavioural signals to produce more accurate individual risk scores for motor policies.

use_cases.name: Predictive underwriting risk scoring — home
use_cases.description: Extend predictive risk scoring to home insurance, incorporating property data, flood risk, subsidence and claims history signals to improve accuracy of home underwriting decisions.

use_cases.name: Underwriting referral assist
use_cases.description: Surface relevant policy, case law and underwriting guidelines to underwriters reviewing non-standard risks, using RAG over the firm's internal knowledge base to reduce research time and improve consistency.

use_cases.name: Automated policy endorsement processing
use_cases.description: Use NLP and rules-based AI to process routine mid-term policy changes (address updates, vehicle substitutions, named driver additions) without human intervention, reducing processing cost and turnaround time.

use_cases.name: AI-powered customer self-service & virtual assistant
use_cases.description: Deploy a conversational AI assistant for customer-facing channels handling policy queries, renewal guidance, claims status updates and basic amendments, reducing contact centre volume.

use_cases.name: Personalised renewal pricing & retention propensity
use_cases.description: Use ML to predict renewal propensity and price sensitivity at individual policyholder level, enabling personalised retention interventions and optimised renewal pricing that balances retention against margin.

use_cases.name: Next best action for inbound customer contacts
use_cases.description: Real-time AI recommendation engine for contact centre agents, suggesting the most appropriate cross-sell, retention or service action based on customer profile, history and current interaction context.

use_cases.name: Complaint root cause analysis & early warning
use_cases.description: Apply NLP to complaints data to identify emerging themes, root causes and systemic issues in near real-time, enabling proactive remediation before issues escalate to regulatory attention.

use_cases.name: Regulatory change impact assessment
use_cases.description: Use AI to monitor incoming regulatory publications and automatically assess their impact on the firm's policies, procedures and products, reducing the manual effort of regulatory horizon scanning.

use_cases.name: Automated conduct risk monitoring
use_cases.description: Apply AI to call recordings, chat logs and written communications to monitor for conduct risk indicators, replacing manual sampling with comprehensive coverage and real-time flagging.

use_cases.name: AI-assisted actuarial reserving
use_cases.description: Use ML models to augment traditional actuarial reserving methods, providing more granular and timely loss development forecasts and reducing the cycle time for reserve reviews.

use_cases.name: Finance process automation — reconciliations
use_cases.description: Apply intelligent automation to routine finance reconciliation processes, using AI to match transactions, identify exceptions and generate exception reports, significantly reducing manual effort at period end.

use_cases.name: Broker relationship scoring & segmentation
use_cases.description: Use ML to score brokers on quality, growth potential and strategic fit, enabling more targeted account management, improved resource allocation and data-driven broker development conversations.

use_cases.name: Intelligent document generation — policy & renewals
use_cases.description: Use generative AI to produce personalised, plain-English policy documents, renewal letters and key facts documents, replacing templated outputs with dynamically generated content tailored to each customer.

use_cases.name: Claims repair network optimisation
use_cases.description: Use ML to optimise the assignment of claims to approved repairers based on cost, quality, capacity, location and customer preference, improving cycle time and customer satisfaction while reducing claims costs.

use_cases.name: Telematics data exploitation — UBI pricing
use_cases.description: Build usage-based insurance (UBI) pricing capability by ingesting and modelling telematics data at scale, enabling more accurate risk segmentation and competitive pricing for low-mileage and low-risk drivers.

use_cases.name: HR & workforce planning intelligence
use_cases.description: Use predictive analytics to model workforce demand, attrition risk and skills gaps, enabling more proactive workforce planning and targeted retention interventions for key roles.

use_cases.name: AI co-pilot for contact centre agents
use_cases.description: Real-time AI assistant for contact centre staff providing suggested responses, policy lookups, next-step guidance and compliance prompts during live customer interactions, reducing handling time and improving consistency.

use_cases.name: Catastrophe (CAT) event claims surge management
use_cases.description: AI-driven triage and resource allocation system for high-volume claims events (storms, floods), automatically prioritising vulnerable customers, allocating handlers and coordinating repair network capacity.

use_cases.name: Pricing optimisation — competitive positioning
use_cases.description: Ingest competitor pricing data and market signals to dynamically inform pricing decisions, enabling more responsive positioning while maintaining target loss ratios. Works alongside actuarial rating models.

use_cases.name: Internal knowledge management assistant
use_cases.description: RAG-based internal assistant enabling staff to query policy documents, process guides, regulatory requirements and product information in natural language, reducing time spent searching for information.

use_cases.name: Vulnerable customer identification & routing
use_cases.description: Apply ML to customer interaction data to identify indicators of vulnerability (financial difficulty, health issues, bereavement) and route customers to appropriately trained staff with relevant support resources.

use_cases.name: Supplier & third-party risk monitoring
use_cases.description: Automated monitoring of key suppliers and outsourced service providers using AI to ingest news, financial data and operational indicators, providing early warning of third-party risk events.

use_cases.name: Automated MI & management reporting
use_cases.description: Use AI to automate the production of routine management information packs, combining data from multiple systems and generating narrative commentary, freeing analyst time for higher-value work.

use_cases.name: Proactive churn prevention — personal lines
use_cases.description: Identify policyholders at high risk of lapse or non-renewal before the renewal window, triggering targeted outreach and personalised retention offers based on predicted price sensitivity and loyalty drivers.
